message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine which charge(s) from the lexicon apply to the fact.

The fact: Coal mine accident due to safety negligence, resulting in death of four workers. The mine's actual controller and legal representative/miner chief were negligent, failed to ensure safety, and after accident concealed and did not report. They are charged under criminal law. Which statutory charge corresponds? In Chinese criminal law, causing death due to negligence in production safety is "过失以危险方法危害公共安全" (negligent dangerous method endangering public safety) or "以危险方法危害公共安全罪" (dangerous method endangering public safety). The lexicon includes "过失以危险方法危害公共安全". That seems appropriate: they were negligent, not intentional. Also there is "隐瞒、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益"? No, that's about concealment of criminal proceeds. Not relevant.

There is also "放火" (arson) not relevant. "故意伤害" not. "故意毁坏财物" not. "非法持有毒品" not. "危险物品肇事" maybe? That is about causing accident with dangerous goods. Not.

Thus the charge is "过失以危险方法危害公共安全". Also possibly "隐瞒事故" but not in list. So answer: [罪名]过失以危险方法危害公共安全<eoa>

Check lexicon: "过失以危险方法危害公共安全" exactly matches. So final.
